server/data/chatbot-small-talk-seed.ts.reason: Seed data, not logic: the reviewed, insert-only dataset of chatbot everyday replies (one object per reply, bounded by tests/chatbot-small-talk-dataset.test.ts). It grows when a reply is added, so growth is not a regression.

server/data/default-translations-seed.ts.reason: Seed data, not logic: the insert-only seed of default languages and translation keys (one line per key). It grows with every new i18n key, so growth is not a regression.

server/db/migrations-additive.ts.reason: Append-only by nature: the ensureColumn/ensureIndex/FK steps that bring databases already holding data up to the schema (design D-R). It grows with every additive migration, so growth is not a regression.
